title: leak #1 lucidmotors
description: In line with our previously discussed approach, the proposed strategy to formally demonstrate to Lucid that we are in possession of their data consists of the controlled upload of approximately 35 GB of technical material.This dataset comprises finite element analysis (FEA/CAE) files, specifically .fem model files, .h3d result files, .out and .spcf output files, together with associated summary reports in .pptx and .xlsx formats. The materials focus on stiffness studies, strain-energy evaluations, displacement assessments, and NVH analyses relating to the mid-sized IC display housing and the Pull/Outboard Switch simulations.
